tool.name: route_document_input_tool
tool.description: Call this first for every uploaded document. It uses the source file extension to choose the intake path. For .docx, call process_docx_tool next; for .pdf, call process_native_pdf_tool next; for .pptx, call process_pptx_tool next; for supported image extensions, call pdf_to_images_converter next. Do not bypass this router or send .doc, .docm, or .xlsx files to a different processor.

document_path.description: S3 URI or absolute path to the uploaded document.

specialist.name: document_intake_router
specialist.description: Routes an uploaded source file to the appropriate BADGERS intake processor by extension.
